raw_segments.text: Enter a king and a queen very lovingly, the queen embracing him and he her.
She kneels and makes show of protestation unto him.
He takes her up and declines his head upon her neck, lays him down upon a bank of flowers.
She seeing him asleep leaves him.
Anon comes in a fellow, takes off his crown, kisses it, pours poison in the king's ears
The queen returns, finds the king dead, and makes passionate action.
The poisoner with some three or four mutes comes in again, seeming to lament with her.
The dead body is carried away.
The poisoner woos the queen with gifts.
She seems loth and unwilling a while, but in the end accepts his love.
